CACHE::payload
Description
Returns the HTTP payload of the cache response.
Syntax
CACHE
::
payload
CACHE::payload
Returns the HTTP payload of the cache response.
Examples
when
CACHE_RESPONSE
{
set
payload
[
CACHE
::
payload
]
}
